انطرقوا (form VII)
# اِنْطَرَقُوا (inṭaraqū) /in.tˤa.ra.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
# اِنْطَرِقُوا (inṭariqū) /in.tˤa.ri.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
